The Credit Maximization Primitive $C_{\text{max}}$ acts as a Lagrange multiplier constraint, ensuring that the owner's intent to maximize output ($\arg\max C$) does not violate the hard budget cap $C_0$. The Generation-to-Publish separation $G \neq P$ enforces a governance firewall: even if generation produces outputs that appear live-ready, they cannot be deployed without explicit human approval. This decouples exploration from exploitation, preventing accidental 'productionizing' of experimental data. The Nova Voice Synthesis kernel $f_{\text{TTS}}$ introduces a non-linear mapping from textual prompts to acoustic waveforms; its stability hinges on the quality of the seed audio, which serves as a prior distribution over desirable voice characteristics.
